blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file carries
# only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository event
# triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a workflow run
    # that queued BEHIND the concurrency group for the whole leg duration
    # (live: gh-317/gh-318 twins, 20:01→20:03); the in-run dedupe gate cannot
    # act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole run pending before any
    # job (incl. dedupe) starts. The awf guard skips status echoes at
    # evaluation, so no double EXECUTION — but the queue clutter was real.
    # Leg dispatching is dispatch-only: the SM dispatches review/rework
    # (workflow_dispatch, inputs.leg), the manual rework override (#544) is a
    # dispatch with leg=rework instead of the agent:rework label.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-266');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes
  # across unrelated PRs.
  group: ai-teammate-issue-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue || format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  dedupe:
    # First-wins: the `issues` trigger fires on assigned AND labeled, so one
    # manual launch can dispatch two dev legs minutes apart (live gh-305 twin,
    # 2026-09-30: 36767724353 in_progress + 36767943650 pending behind the
    # concurrency group, both event=issues). The concurrency group only
    # SERIALIZES twins — this gate makes the younger run self-cancel when an
    # older live run of this workflow already anchors the same issue/pr.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      duplicate: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.duplicate }}
    steps:
      - name: Self-cancel if an identical live leg already holds the anchor
        id: gate
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ANCHOR: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue || format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr) }}
        run: |
          case "$ANCHOR" in
            pr-*) T="$ANCHOR" ;;
            *)    T="gh-$ANCHOR" ;;
          esac
          LIVE=$( { gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow ai-teammate.yml --status in_progress --json databaseId,displayTitle --jq '.[]'
                    gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow ai-teammate.yml --status queued    --json databaseId,displayTitle --jq '.[]'
                    gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow ai-teammate.yml --status pending   --json databaseId,displayTitle --jq '.[]'
                  } | jq -s --argjson self '${{ github.run_id }}' --arg t "$T" '
                    [ .[]
                      | select(.databaseId != $self)
                      | select(.displayTitle | test("(^|[^0-9])" + $t + "([^0-9]|$)")) ]
                    | length')
          if [ "${LIVE:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::notice::identical live leg holds $T — cancelling this duplicate ($LIVE holder(s) found)"
            echo "duplicate=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            gh run cancel "${{ github.run_id }}" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" || true
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "duplicate=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  factory:
    needs: dedupe
    if: needs.dedupe.outputs.duplicate != 'true'
    # TWO PINS, never conflated (see test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart):
    #   uses:  — the FACTORY HOME pin (dmtools-agentic-workflows). Moves
    #            only when the factory home changes; never bumped with
    #            the agents submodule.
    #   factory_ref: — the ENGINE pin (dmtools-agents, == the `agents`
    #            submodule gitlink). Bumps in lockstep with the submodule.
    # The uses: ref tracks awf main (always-latest, owner 2026-10-04 —
    # review-gated); the engine pin (factory_ref = submodule gitlink)
    # stays an immutable SHA.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml@main
    with:
      # The literal uses-ref: the factory requires it (it cannot derive its
      # own ref — github.workflow_ref in a called workflow is the CALLER's).
      factory_ref: d22a4f1032e2cd441200ed1a8309234985385fd2
      # Bitrise Build Hub pool (epam-org visible; probe #229).
      runner: BITRISE-RUNNER-DMTOOLS-CI
      issue: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
      leg: ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || '' }}
      reason: ${{ github.event.inputs.reason || 'stub' }}
      pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr || '' }}
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      # Provider-key slots (generic, awf 75c72a6): slot -> key mapping is
      # documented HERE, next to the secret reference. Slot 1 carries the
      # copilot enterprise token (copilot provider, first in the queue —
      # see .dmtools/runners/*.json apiKeyEnv). Slots 2-3 free.
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME: COPILOT_EPAM_KEY
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect: inherit => startup failure, explicit => green).
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ZAI_CODE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_CODE_KEY }}
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY: ${{ secrets.KIMI_REVIEW_KEY }}
      # Slot 1 = COPILOT_EPAM_KEY — plain repo secret, runner-masked
      # natively; the factory exports it into the agent job env under the
      # name given in with.CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME above.
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1: ${{ secrets.COPILOT_EPAM_KEY }}
# DMTOOLS_PACK_REGISTRY (pack registry base) is read by the factory from
# this repo's VARIABLE of the same name — see dmtools-agents#574.

blocks.text:
# AGENTS.md — rules for working in dmtools-dart

Pure Dart port of DMTools (Java/GraalJS → Dart/QuickJS). **Read `GOAL.md` first —
it is the spec.** This file is the operating manual: rules, commands, layout.

---

## 1. Non-negotiable rules

1. **crap4dart is law.** CRAP threshold **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml`), tool
   pinned to **0.9.5** in CI (and locally; keep both in sync). Pre-commit hook
   runs `crap4dart check --staged`; CI runs `check --all` + `analyze` on every push.
   Never commit on red, never weaken a gate to make code pass. Known
   exemptions live in `crap4dart.yaml` with comments (Java-parity client
   classes → class_size warning; testrail_create_case* Java-parity
   @MCPParam signatures → method_size max_params override).
2. **Signature parity with Java DMTools.** Config JSON keys, tool names
   (snake_case), env variables, CLI commands — identical to the Java version.
   A config or `dmtools.env` that works with Java must work unchanged here.
   When behavior is ambiguous, **the Java source is the spec**; record the decision
   in the commit message.
3. **No JVM, no GraalVM.** Dart only. JS runtime is QuickJS via `dart:ffi` with
   synchronous host calls (not the `flutter_js` plugin), consumed from the
   **`quickjs_runtime` package** (github.com/IstiN/quickjs_runtime, git dep in
   `pubspec.yaml`) — never vendored here. Build the native library with
   `make native` (or `bash "$QUICKJS_PKG/tool/build_quickjs.sh"`); the .so is
   built inside the package checkout and found via
   `.dart_tool/package_config.json` (override with `JSR_QUICKJS_LIB`).
4. **Thin `bin/`.** CI coverage is collected with `--report-on lib`, so `bin/` is
   outside LCOV. All logic lives in `lib/`; `bin/` only parses argv and delegates.
5. **Tests ship with code.** Coverage gate is 80% (`gates.test_coverage`).
   Test code is held to the same bar (`sources: [lib, bin, test]`).
6. **Never commit secrets.** `dmtools.env` / `dmtools-local.env` are git-ignored;
   keep them that way. Credentials in tests come only from the standard config
   resolution chain (see GOAL.md → Integration testing strategy).

## 2. Where things are

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `GOAL.md` | **The spec**: mission, constraints, audit facts, phases 0–5, test strategy |
| `crap4dart.yaml` | Quality gate config (threshold 8.0, sources lib/bin/test) |
| `.github/workflows/quality.yml` | CI: format → analyze → test+coverage → crap4dart |
| `bin/dmtools.dart` | CLI entry (stub; full JobRunner surface = Phase 2) |
| `install.sh` | One-line installer: prebuilt AOT binaries from GitHub Releases (see `release-cli.yml` / `install-test.yml`) |
| `lib/` | All implementation code |
| `test/` | `dart test` suite (L1 unit; L2 contract fixtures later) |

Java reference implementation (read-only, the spec for behavior):
**https://github.com/epam/dm.ai** — clone it fresh (always the latest upstream);
key files are named per phase in GOAL.md (e.g. `PropertyReader.java`,
`JobRunner.java`, `JobJavaScriptBridge.java`, `cliagent/CliAgent.java`).
Agent scripts and the JS test suite: **https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents**.
JS runtime (`jsr`) extensions go to **https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime**
via fork + PR — never vendored here (see GOAL.md).

## 3. Local dev loop

```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH"   # crap4dart lives here; without it the
                                           # pre-commit hook SKIPS checks silently

dart pub get
make native                               # build the QuickJS .so (quickjs_runtime pkg)
dart format .                              # CI fails on unformatted code
dart analyze

#
# The dev→review→rework machine loop for GitHub-issues trackers, hosted in
# dmtools-agents so target repositories carry only a thin stub (event
# triggers + this call) plus .dmtools/config.js, secrets and vars. Runs in
# the CALLER's context: github.repository = the target repo; vars.* and
# secrets.* resolve from the caller (each target pins its own versions).
#
# Legs (guard derives the slot when `leg` is empty):
#   bug | story | review | rework — the runner configs live in the TARGET repo
#   (.dmtools/runners/*), wired via .dmtools/config.js sm.runners.
#
# Loop mechanics (identical to the dmtools-dart template this was ported
# from — see that file's history for the full rationale):
#   issue assigned/labeled → guard → ticket input → dmtools run <runner>
#   → agent develops → PR ("Closes #NN") → review verdict step:
#       APPROVE + green PR checks → pr_approved → merge (merge-trigger/stub)
#       CHANGES_REQUESTED        → agent:rework (bounded: MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS,
#                                  then needs-human escalation)
#   Review/rework queue labels are stripped at cycle end (no self-loops).
#   fa sessions ride the fa-sess/gh-<n> branch (cache saves are denied on
#   issues-event runs); fa project memory is committed back to the repo.
#
# Secrets (via `secrets: inherit`): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (PAT — labels added
#   with GITHUB_TOKEN never fire `labeled` events; pushes must not author
#   as github-actions[bot]), ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY.
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
#   MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS (default 2).
#
# Caller stub:
#   on:
#     issues: {types: [assigned, labeled]}
#     workflow_dispatch: {inputs: {issue: {type: number}, leg: {type: string}}}
#   concurrency:
#     group: ai-teammate-issue-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue }}
#     cancel-in-progress: false
#   jobs:
#     factory:
#       uses: IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml@<ref>
#       with:
#         issue: ${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue }}
#         leg: ${{ inputs.leg || '' }}
#         reason: ${{ inputs.reason || 'stub' }}
#       secrets: inherit

name: 'Factory · AI Teammate'

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner:
        description: 'Runner label (self-hosted pools must be visible to the CALLING org)'
        type: string
        default: 'ubuntu-24.04'
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (string: number-typed reusable inputs cannot take expressions). Empty when pr is given (PR-anchored run, #687).'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687). Exactly one of issue|pr must be set.'
        required: false
        type: string
      machine-author:
        description: "Deployment's machine (bot) login (#687): gates rework re-arm in PR-anchored reviews (auto-approve via pr_approved is author-agnostic per the owner rule). Injected as jobParams.machineAuthor — branch-independent (the checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config)."
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: "Which leg to run: dev | review | rework (empty = derive from labels/assignees)"
        required: false
        type: string
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      factory_ref:
        description: 'The dmtools-agents ref the factory runs from (the literal in the stub uses-line). github.workflow_ref cannot serve: in a called workflow it carries the CALLER ref, not the uses-ref.'
        required: true
        type: string
      flutter-version:
        description: 'Flutter SDK for agent work (cached). "" (default) installs NOTHING — most consumers are not Flutter projects and bring their own toolchain via the setup/install scripts. A value installs Flutter+matching Dart via flutter-action with SDK caching (e.g. "stable", "3.38.0"); Flutter targets (fa) pass it explicitly.'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 1 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY2_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 2 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY3_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 3 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string

    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN:
        description: 'PAT with repo scope — machine labels, pushes, PR/issue API (secrets: inherit does not cross repository boundaries).'
        required: true
      ZAI_CODE_KEY:
        description: 'z.ai API key (dev/rework provider + review queue fallback)'
        required: false
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY:
        description: 'kimi API key (review provider, first in the queue)'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 1 — value lands in the agent job env under CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME. The factory never knows key names; the caller stub documents which repo secret maps here.'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY2:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 2 — see CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1.'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY3:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 3 — see CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1.'
        required: false

# NOTE: no `concurrency` here — the caller stub owns the per-issue group.
# A reusable workflow with the SAME group as its caller deadlocks: the caller
# holds the group while the called workflow waits for it forever (pending, 0 jobs).

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  # actions/cache@v6 save phase needs actions:write on github.token.
  actions: write

jobs:
  guard:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.check.outputs.run }}
      runner: ${{ steps.check.outputs.runner }}
      config: ${{ steps.check.outputs.config }}
      kind: ${{ steps.check.outputs.kind }}
      anchor: ${{ steps.check.outputs.anchor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout target repository (config, runners)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # caller-repo checkout: the factory reads .dmtools/config.js from
          # the TARGET repository, never from the factory pack
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          # gate job only: config.js at the head + API guards — no git
          # history walks. fetch-depth 0 cloned the FULL history here
          # (~1 min on fa, every leg) for nothing.
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Decide whether this event is for the agent
        id: check
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          # Event context rides through from the caller (issues events) —
          # empty for pure dispatches. The guard ALWAYS refreshes from the
          # API (queued runs see a stale payload); this is only a fallback.
          ASSIGNEES: ${{ join(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login, ' ') }}
          LABELS: ${{ join(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, ' ') }}
          ACTOR: ${{ github.event.action || github.event_name }}
          # #544: the `labeled` event sender — the owner-override gate checks
          # its repo permission before honoring a manual agent:rework.
          # Empty for schedule-scan dispatches (SM ticks): the label is
          # trusted as-is there (see rework_override_ok below).
          SENDER: ${{ github.event.sender.login || '' }}
          INPUT_LEG: ${{ inputs.leg }}
          INPUT_REASON: ${{ inputs.reason }}
          # The assignee gate below compares against the machine login.
          # AGENT_HANDLE lives on the TEAMMATE job's env — without it here…

#!/bin/bash
# Fa provider for run-agent.sh
#
# fa headless contract (env preconfig — the declaration is machine-written
# and self-contained; fa never guesses catalog defaults):
#   FA_PROVIDER_TYPE  …

blocks.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Fa provider for run-agent.sh
#
# fa headless contract (env preconfig — the declaration is machine-written
# and self-contained; fa never guesses catalog defaults):
#   FA_PROVIDER_TYPE     (required) catalog provider kind: anthropic,
#                        google, dial, openai-completions, zai, aiin,
#                        minimax, chatgpt-codex, copilot, codemie,
#                        ollama, openai, openrouter, kimi, …
#   FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG   (required, JSON) {"baseUrl": …, "model": …,
#                        "apiKeyEnvVar": …} — baseUrl and model are
#                        mandatory (fa fails the boot without them),
#                        apiKeyEnvVar names the env var that carries the
#                        API key (its _BASE64 twin also accepted)
#   FA_PROVIDER_NAME     (optional) unique entry name override
#   FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY  (optional) convenience: mapped into the env var
#                        the config's apiKeyEnvVar names — ONLY inside
#                        the fa subprocess scope
#
# Sessions (when agents/setup/fa-session.sh is present, e.g. AI Teammate
# runs): --session "$FA_SESSION_NAME" --session-root "$FA_SESSION_ROOT"
# resume-or-create the deterministic named session for repo:ticket:group.

_fa_resolve_env() {
  if [ -z "${FA_PROVIDER_TYPE:-}" ]; then
    echo "Error: FA_PROVIDER_TYPE environment variable is required for fa provider" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  if [ -z "${FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG:-}" ]; then
    echo "Error: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG is required for fa provider — a JSON object with at least {\"baseUrl\", \"model\"} (fa never guesses catalog defaults), e.g." >&2
    echo "  FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG='{\"baseUrl\":\"https://ai-proxy.lab.epam.com\",\"model\":\"gpt-4o\",\"apiKeyEnvVar\":\"DIAL_API_KEY\"}'" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # Surface the config's key env var name so the runner can map
  # FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY into it for the subprocess when the var itself
  # is unset.
  FA_KEY_ENV_VAR="$(printf '%s' "${FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG}" | sed -n 's/.*"apiKeyEnvVar"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"
}

run_fa() {
  _fa_resolve_env || return 1

  _fa_configure_session

  echo "Fa Configuration:"
  echo "  Provider Type: ${FA_PROVIDER_TYPE}"
  [ -n "${FA_PROVIDER_NAME:-}" ] && echo "  Entry Name: ${FA_PROVIDER_NAME}"
  echo "  Config: ${FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG}"

  local pass_args=()
  local arg
  for arg in ${PASS_ARGS[@]+"${PASS_ARGS[@]}"}; do
    case "$arg" in
      --continue|--resume) ;;
      *) pass_args+=("$arg") ;;
    esac
  done

  # Provider selection is driven entirely by the FA_PROVIDER_* env
  # preconfig (fa precedence: explicit flags > preconfig > saved config).
  # No --provider/--model/--base-url flags here — the env declaration is
  # the single source of truth and pins every model role.
  local cmd
  cmd=(fa)
  if [ -n "${FA_SESSION_NAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${FA_SESSION_ROOT:-}" ]; then
    cmd+=(--session "${FA_SESSION_NAME}" --session-root "${FA_SESSION_ROOT}")
  fi
  # FA_LOG_FILE (optional): tee fa's full stdout trace (assistant text, tool
  # calls) to this file — untruncated, unlike the terminal-width trajectory
  # rows. CI tails/uploads it; requires fa >= v0.1.335 (--log-file).
  # Callers can still pass --log-file explicitly via PASS_ARGS.
  if [ -n "${FA_LOG_FILE:-}" ] \
    && ! printf '%s\n' ${pass_args[@]+"${pass_args[@]}"} | grep -qx -- '--log-file'; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "${FA_LOG_FILE}")"
    cmd+=(--log-file "${FA_LOG_FILE}")
  fi
  cmd+=(${pass_args[@]+"${pass_args[@]}"} -p "$PROMPT")

  echo "Working directory: $(pwd)"
  echo ""
  echo "Running: ${cmd[*]}"
  echo ""

  local agent_log
  agent_log="$(mktemp)"

  # Map FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY into the env var the config's apiKeyEnvVar
  # names — ONLY for the fa subprocess (claude.sh maps CLAUDE_CODE_* →
  # ANTHROPIC_* the same way) so it never leaks into the surrounding job
  # environment. When the caller already exported the named var, fa reads
  # it directly and nothing is injected.
  set +e
  if [ -n "${FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY:-}" ] && [ -n "${FA_KEY_ENV_VAR:-}" ] \
     && [ -z "$(eval "echo \${${FA_KEY_ENV_VAR}:-}")" ]; then
    env "${FA_KEY_ENV_VAR}=${FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY}" "${cmd[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$agent_log"
  else
    "${cmd[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$agent_log"
  fi
  local exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  set -e

  record_codegraph_usage "$agent_log"
  rm -f "$agent_log"

  echo ""
  echo "=== Agent completed with exit code: $exit_code ==="
  return $exit_code
}

# Configure the deterministic session when the setup script is available
# (repo-local runs may not have it — fa then runs without a named session).
# Runs inside run_fa's caller context, NOT at source time: sourcing here
# would otherwise run before the provider env validation and leak setup
# vars into unrelated shells.
_fa_configure_session() {
  local setup_dir
  setup_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../setup" 2>/dev/null && pwd || true)"
  if [ -z "${FA_SESSION_NAME:-}" ] && [ -f "${setup_dir}/fa-session.sh" ]; then
    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    source "${setup_dir}/fa-session.sh" env
  fi
}

# Factory · AI Teammate leg — REUSABLE workflow (dmtools-agents factory pack, top-level: GitHub requires reusable workflows at the .github/workflows root — no subdirectories).
#
# The dev→review→rewor…

blocks.text:
# Factory · AI Teammate leg — REUSABLE workflow (dmtools-agents factory pack, top-level: GitHub requires reusable workflows at the .github/workflows root — no subdirectories).
#
# The dev→review→rework machine loop for GitHub-issues trackers, hosted in
# dmtools-agents so target repositories carry only a thin stub (event
# triggers + this call) plus .dmtools/config.js, secrets and vars. Runs in
# the CALLER's context: github.repository = the target repo; vars.* and
# secrets.* resolve from the caller (each target pins its own versions).
#
# Legs (guard derives the slot when `leg` is empty):
#   bug | story | review | rework — the runner configs live in the TARGET repo
#   (.dmtools/runners/*), wired via .dmtools/config.js sm.runners.
#
# Loop mechanics (identical to the dmtools-dart template this was ported
# from — see that file's history for the full rationale):
#   issue assigned/labeled → guard → ticket input → dmtools run <runner>
#   → agent develops → PR ("Closes #NN") → review verdict step:
#       APPROVE + green PR checks → pr_approved → merge (merge-trigger/stub)
#       CHANGES_REQUESTED        → agent:rework (bounded: MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS,
#                                  then needs-human escalation)
#   Review/rework queue labels are stripped at cycle end (no self-loops).
#   fa sessions ride the fa-sess/gh-<n> branch (cache saves are denied on
#   issues-event runs); fa project memory is committed back to the repo.
#
# Secrets (via `secrets: inherit`): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (PAT — labels added
#   with GITHUB_TOKEN never fire `labeled` events; pushes must not author
#   as github-actions[bot]), ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY.
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
#   MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS (default 2).
#
# Caller stub:
#   on:
#     issues: {types: [assigned, labeled]}
#     workflow_dispatch: {inputs: {issue: {type: number}, leg: {type: string}}}
#   concurrency:
#     group: ai-teammate-issue-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue }}
#     cancel-in-progress: false
#   jobs:
#     factory:
#       uses: IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml@<ref>
#       with:
#         issue: ${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue }}
#         leg: ${{ inputs.leg || '' }}
#         reason: ${{ inputs.reason || 'stub' }}
#       secrets: inherit

name: 'Factory · AI Teammate'

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner:
        description: 'Runner label (self-hosted pools must be visible to the CALLING org)'
        type: string
        default: 'ubuntu-24.04'
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (string: number-typed reusable inputs cannot take expressions). Empty when pr is given (PR-anchored run, #687).'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687). Exactly one of issue|pr must be set.'
        required: false
        type: string
      machine-author:
        description: "Deployment's machine (bot) login (#687): gates rework re-arm in PR-anchored reviews (auto-approve via pr_approved is author-agnostic per the owner rule). Injected as jobParams.machineAuthor — branch-independent (the checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config)."
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: "Which leg to run: dev | review | rework (empty = derive from labels/assignees)"
        required: false
        type: string
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      factory_ref:
        description: 'The dmtools-agents ref the factory runs from (the literal in the stub uses-line). github.workflow_ref cannot serve: in a called workflow it carries the CALLER ref, not the uses-ref.'
        required: true
        type: string
      flutter-version:
        description: 'Flutter SDK for agent work (cached). "" (default) installs NOTHING — most consumers are not Flutter projects and bring their own toolchain via the setup/install scripts. A value installs Flutter+matching Dart via flutter-action with SDK caching (e.g. "stable", "3.38.0"); Flutter targets (fa) pass it explicitly.'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 1 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY2_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 2 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY3_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 3 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string

    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN:
        description: 'PAT with repo scope — machine labels, pushes, PR/issue API (secrets: inherit does not cross repository boundaries).'
        required: true
      ZAI_CODE_KEY:
        description: 'z.ai API key (dev/rework provider + review queue fallback)'
        required: false
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY:
        description: 'kimi API key (review provider, first in the queue)'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 1 — value lands in the agent job env under CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME. The factory never knows key names; the caller stub documents which repo secret maps here.'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY2:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 2 — see CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1.'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY3:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 3 — see CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1.'
        required: false

# NOTE: no `concurrency` here — the caller stub owns the per-issue group.
# A reusable workflow with the SAME group as its caller deadlocks: the caller
# holds the group while the called workflow waits for it forever (pending, 0 jobs).

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  # actions/cache@v6 save phase needs actions:write on github.token.
  actions: write

jobs:
  guard:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.check.outputs.run }}
      runner: ${{ steps.check.outputs.runner }}
      config: ${{ steps.check.outputs.config }}
      kind: ${{ steps.check.outputs.kind }}
      anchor: ${{ steps.check.outputs.anchor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout target repository (config, runners)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # caller-repo checkout: the factory reads .dmtools/config.js from
          # the TARGET repository, never from the factory pack
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          # gate job only: config.js at the head + API guards — no git
          # history walks. fetch-depth 0 cloned the FULL history here
          # (~1 min on fa, every leg) for nothing.
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Decide whether this event is for the agent
        id: check
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          # Event context rides through from the caller (issues events) —
          # empty for pure dispatches. The guard ALWAYS refreshes from the
          # API (queued runs see a stale payload); this is only a fallback.

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file carries
# only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository event
# triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a workflow run
    # that queued BEHIND the concurrency group for the whole leg duration
    # (live: gh-317/gh-318 twins, 20:01→20:03); the in-run dedupe gate cannot
    # act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole run pending before any
    # job (incl. dedupe) starts. The awf guard skips status echoes at
    # evaluation, so no double EXECUTION — but the queue clutter was real.
    # Leg dispatching is dispatch-only: the SM dispatches review/rework
    # (workflow_dispatch, inputs.leg), the manual rework override (#544) is a
    # dispatch with leg=rework instead of the agent:rework label.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-266');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes
  # across unrelated PRs.
  group: ai-teammate-issue-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue || format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  dedupe:
    # First-wins: the `issues` trigger fires on assigned AND labeled, so one
    # manual launch can dispatch two dev legs minutes apart (live gh-305 twin,
    # 2026-09-30: 36767724353 in_progress + 36767943650 pending behind the
    # concurrency group, both event=issues). The concurrency group only
    # SERIALIZES twins — this gate makes the younger run self-cancel when an
    # older live run of this workflow already anchors the same issue/pr.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      duplicate: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.duplicate }}
    steps:
      - name: Self-cancel if an identical live leg already holds the anchor
        id: gate
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ANCHOR: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue || format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr) }}
        run: |
          case "$ANCHOR" in
            pr-*) T="$ANCHOR" ;;
            *)    T="gh-$ANCHOR" ;;
          esac
          LIVE=$( { gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow ai-teammate.yml --status in_progress --json databaseId,displayTitle --jq '.[]'
                    gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow ai-teammate.yml --status queued    --json databaseId,displayTitle --jq '.[]'
                    gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow ai-teammate.yml --status pending   --json databaseId,displayTitle --jq '.[]'
                  } | jq -s --argjson self '${{ github.run_id }}' --arg t "$T" '
                    [ .[]
                      | select(.databaseId != $self)
                      | select(.displayTitle | test("(^|[^0-9])" + $t + "([^0-9]|$)")) ]
                    | length')
          if [ "${LIVE:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::notice::identical live leg holds $T — cancelling this duplicate ($LIVE holder(s) found)"
            echo "duplicate=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            gh run cancel "${{ github.run_id }}" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" || true
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "duplicate=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  factory:
    needs: dedupe
    if: needs.dedupe.outputs.duplicate != 'true'
    # TWO PINS, never conflated (see test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart):
    #   uses:  — the FACTORY HOME pin (dmtools-agentic-workflows). Moves
    #            only when the factory home changes; never bumped with
    #            the agents submodule.
    #   factory_ref: — the ENGINE pin (dmtools-agents, == the `agents`
    #            submodule gitlink). Bumps in lockstep with the submodule.
    # The uses: ref tracks awf main (always-latest, owner 2026-10-04 —
    # review-gated); the engine pin (factory_ref = submodule gitlink)
    # stays an immutable SHA.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml@main
    with:
      # The literal uses-ref: the factory requires it (it cannot derive its
      # own ref — github.workflow_ref in a called workflow is the CALLER's).
      factory_ref: d22a4f1032e2cd441200ed1a8309234985385fd2
      # Bitrise Build Hub pool (epam-org visible; probe #229).
      runner: BITRISE-RUNNER-DMTOOLS-CI
      issue: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
      leg: ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || '' }}
      reason: ${{ github.event.inputs.reason || 'stub' }}
      pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr || '' }}
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      # Provider-key slots (generic, awf 75c72a6): slot -> key mapping is
      # documented HERE, next to the secret reference. Slot 1 carries the
      # copilot enterprise token (copilot provider, first in the queue —
      # see .dmtools/runners/*.json apiKeyEnv). Slots 2-3 free.
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME: COPILOT_EPAM_KEY
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect: inherit => startup failure, explicit => green).
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ZAI_CODE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_CODE_KEY }}
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY: ${{ secrets.KIMI_REVIEW_KEY }}
      # Slot 1 = COPILOT_EPAM_KEY — plain repo secret, runner-masked
      # natively; the factory exports it into the agent job env under the
      # name given in with.CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME above.
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1: ${{ secrets.COPILOT_EPAM_KEY }}
# DMTOOLS_PACK_REGISTRY (pack registry base) is read by the factory from
# this repo's VARIABLE of the same name — see dmtools-agents#574.

blocks.text:
# AGENTS.md — rules for working in dmtools-dart

Pure Dart port of DMTools (Java/GraalJS → Dart/QuickJS). **Read `GOAL.md` first —
it is the spec.** This file is the operating manual: rules, commands, layout.

---

## 1. Non-negotiable rules

1. **crap4dart is law.** CRAP threshold **8.0** (`crap4dart.yaml`), tool
   pinned to **0.9.5** in CI (and locally; keep both in sync). Pre-commit hook
   runs `crap4dart check --staged`; CI runs `check --all` + `analyze` on every push.
   Never commit on red, never weaken a gate to make code pass. Known
   exemptions live in `crap4dart.yaml` with comments (Java-parity client
   classes → class_size warning; testrail_create_case* Java-parity
   @MCPParam signatures → method_size max_params override).
2. **Signature parity with Java DMTools.** Config JSON keys, tool names
   (snake_case), env variables, CLI commands — identical to the Java version.
   A config or `dmtools.env` that works with Java must work unchanged here.
   When behavior is ambiguous, **the Java source is the spec**; record the decision
   in the commit message.
3. **No JVM, no GraalVM.** Dart only. JS runtime is QuickJS via `dart:ffi` with
   synchronous host calls (not the `flutter_js` plugin), consumed from the
   **`quickjs_runtime` package** (github.com/IstiN/quickjs_runtime, git dep in
   `pubspec.yaml`) — never vendored here. Build the native library with
   `make native` (or `bash "$QUICKJS_PKG/tool/build_quickjs.sh"`); the .so is
   built inside the package checkout and found via
   `.dart_tool/package_config.json` (override with `JSR_QUICKJS_LIB`).
4. **Thin `bin/`.** CI coverage is collected with `--report-on lib`, so `bin/` is
   outside LCOV. All logic lives in `lib/`; `bin/` only parses argv and delegates.
5. **Tests ship with code.** Coverage gate is 80% (`gates.test_coverage`).
   Test code is held to the same bar (`sources: [lib, bin, test]`).
6. **Never commit secrets.** `dmtools.env` / `dmtools-local.env` are git-ignored;
   keep them that way. Credentials in tests come only from the standard config
   resolution chain (see GOAL.md → Integration testing strategy).

## 2. Where things are

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `GOAL.md` | **The spec**: mission, constraints, audit facts, phases 0–5, test strategy |
| `crap4dart.yaml` | Quality gate config (threshold 8.0, sources lib/bin/test) |
| `.github/workflows/quality.yml` | CI: format → analyze → test+coverage → crap4dart |
| `bin/dmtools.dart` | CLI entry (stub; full JobRunner surface = Phase 2) |
| `install.sh` | One-line installer: prebuilt AOT binaries from GitHub Releases (see `release-cli.yml` / `install-test.yml`) |
| `lib/` | All implementation code |
| `test/` | `dart test` suite (L1 unit; L2 contract fixtures later) |

Java reference implementation (read-only, the spec for behavior):
**https://github.com/epam/dm.ai** — clone it fresh (always the latest upstream);
key files are named per phase in GOAL.md (e.g. `PropertyReader.java`,
`JobRunner.java`, `JobJavaScriptBridge.java`, `cliagent/CliAgent.java`).
Agent scripts and the JS test suite: **https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents**.
JS runtime (`jsr`) extensions go to **https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime**
via fork + PR — never vendored here (see GOAL.md).

## 3. Local dev loop

```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH"   # crap4dart lives here; without it the
                                           # pre-commit hook SKIPS checks silently

dart pub get
make native                               # build the QuickJS .so (quickjs_runtime pkg)
dart format .                              # CI fails on unformatted code
dart analyze

#
# The dev→review→rework machine loop for GitHub-issues trackers, hosted in
# dmtools-agents so target repositories carry only a thin stub (event
# triggers + this call) plus .dmtools/config.js, secrets and vars. Runs in
# the CALLER's context: github.repository = the target repo; vars.* and
# secrets.* resolve from the caller (each target pins its own versions).
#
# Legs (guard derives the slot when `leg` is empty):
#   bug | story | review | rework — the runner configs live in the TARGET repo
#   (.dmtools/runners/*), wired via .dmtools/config.js sm.runners.
#
# Loop mechanics (identical to the dmtools-dart template this was ported
# from — see that file's history for the full rationale):
#   issue assigned/labeled → guard → ticket input → dmtools run <runner>
#   → agent develops → PR ("Closes #NN") → review verdict step:
#       APPROVE + green PR checks → pr_approved → merge (merge-trigger/stub)
#       CHANGES_REQUESTED        → agent:rework (bounded: MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS,
#                                  then needs-human escalation)
#   Review/rework queue labels are stripped at cycle end (no self-loops).
#   fa sessions ride the fa-sess/gh-<n> branch (cache saves are denied on
#   issues-event runs); fa project memory is committed back to the repo.
#
# Secrets (via `secrets: inherit`): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (PAT — labels added
#   with GITHUB_TOKEN never fire `labeled` events; pushes must not author
#   as github-actions[bot]), ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY.
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
#   MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS (default 2).
#
# Caller stub:
#   on:
#     issues: {types: [assigned, labeled]}
#     workflow_dispatch: {inputs: {issue: {type: number}, leg: {type: string}}}
#   concurrency:
#     group: ai-teammate-issue-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue }}
#     cancel-in-progress: false
#   jobs:
#     factory:
#       uses: IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml@<ref>
#       with:
#         issue: ${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue }}
#         leg: ${{ inputs.leg || '' }}
#         reason: ${{ inputs.reason || 'stub' }}
#       secrets: inherit

name: 'Factory · AI Teammate'

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner:
        description: 'Runner label (self-hosted pools must be visible to the CALLING org)'
        type: string
        default: 'ubuntu-24.04'
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (string: number-typed reusable inputs cannot take expressions). Empty when pr is given (PR-anchored run, #687).'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687). Exactly one of issue|pr must be set.'
        required: false
        type: string
      machine-author:
        description: "Deployment's machine (bot) login (#687): gates rework re-arm in PR-anchored reviews (auto-approve via pr_approved is author-agnostic per the owner rule). Injected as jobParams.machineAuthor — branch-independent (the checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config)."
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: "Which leg to run: dev | review | rework (empty = derive from labels/assignees)"
        required: false
        type: string
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      factory_ref:
        description: 'The dmtools-agents ref the factory runs from (the literal in the stub uses-line). github.workflow_ref cannot serve: in a called workflow it carries the CALLER ref, not the uses-ref.'
        required: true
        type: string
      flutter-version:
        description: 'Flutter SDK for agent work (cached). "" (default) installs NOTHING — most consumers are not Flutter projects and bring their own toolchain via the setup/install scripts. A value installs Flutter+matching Dart via flutter-action with SDK caching (e.g. "stable", "3.38.0"); Flutter targets (fa) pass it explicitly.'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 1 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY2_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 2 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY3_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 3 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string

    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN:
        description: 'PAT with repo scope — machine labels, pushes, PR/issue API (secrets: inherit does not cross repository boundaries).'
        required: true
      ZAI_CODE_KEY:
        description: 'z.ai API key (dev/rework provider + review queue fallback)'
        required: false
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY:
        description: 'kimi API key (review provider, first in the queue)'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 1 — value lands in the agent job env under CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME. The factory never knows key names; the caller stub documents which repo secret maps here.'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY2:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 2 — see CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1.'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY3:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 3 — see CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1.'
        required: false

# NOTE: no `concurrency` here — the caller stub owns the per-issue group.
# A reusable workflow with the SAME group as its caller deadlocks: the caller
# holds the group while the called workflow waits for it forever (pending, 0 jobs).

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  # actions/cache@v6 save phase needs actions:write on github.token.
  actions: write

jobs:
  guard:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.check.outputs.run }}
      runner: ${{ steps.check.outputs.runner }}
      config: ${{ steps.check.outputs.config }}
      kind: ${{ steps.check.outputs.kind }}
      anchor: ${{ steps.check.outputs.anchor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout target repository (config, runners)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # caller-repo checkout: the factory reads .dmtools/config.js from
          # the TARGET repository, never from the factory pack
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          # gate job only: config.js at the head + API guards — no git
          # history walks. fetch-depth 0 cloned the FULL history here
          # (~1 min on fa, every leg) for nothing.
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Decide whether this event is for the agent
        id: check
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          # Event context rides through from the caller (issues events) —
          # empty for pure dispatches. The guard ALWAYS refreshes from the
          # API (queued runs see a stale payload); this is only a fallback.
          ASSIGNEES: ${{ join(github.event.issue.assignees.*.login, ' ') }}
          LABELS: ${{ join(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, ' ') }}
          ACTOR: ${{ github.event.action || github.event_name }}
          # #544: the `labeled` event sender — the owner-override gate checks
          # its repo permission before honoring a manual agent:rework.
          # Empty for schedule-scan dispatches (SM ticks): the label is
          # trusted as-is there (see rework_override_ok below).
          SENDER: ${{ github.event.sender.login || '' }}
          INPUT_LEG: ${{ inputs.leg }}
          INPUT_REASON: ${{ inputs.reason }}
          # The assignee gate below compares against the machine login.
          # AGENT_HANDLE lives on the TEAMMATE job's env — without it here…

#!/bin/bash
# Fa provider for run-agent.sh
#
# fa headless contract (env preconfig — the declaration is machine-written
# and self-contained; fa never guesses catalog defaults):
#   FA_PROVIDER_TYPE  …

blocks.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Fa provider for run-agent.sh
#
# fa headless contract (env preconfig — the declaration is machine-written
# and self-contained; fa never guesses catalog defaults):
#   FA_PROVIDER_TYPE     (required) catalog provider kind: anthropic,
#                        google, dial, openai-completions, zai, aiin,
#                        minimax, chatgpt-codex, copilot, codemie,
#                        ollama, openai, openrouter, kimi, …
#   FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG   (required, JSON) {"baseUrl": …, "model": …,
#                        "apiKeyEnvVar": …} — baseUrl and model are
#                        mandatory (fa fails the boot without them),
#                        apiKeyEnvVar names the env var that carries the
#                        API key (its _BASE64 twin also accepted)
#   FA_PROVIDER_NAME     (optional) unique entry name override
#   FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY  (optional) convenience: mapped into the env var
#                        the config's apiKeyEnvVar names — ONLY inside
#                        the fa subprocess scope
#
# Sessions (when agents/setup/fa-session.sh is present, e.g. AI Teammate
# runs): --session "$FA_SESSION_NAME" --session-root "$FA_SESSION_ROOT"
# resume-or-create the deterministic named session for repo:ticket:group.

_fa_resolve_env() {
  if [ -z "${FA_PROVIDER_TYPE:-}" ]; then
    echo "Error: FA_PROVIDER_TYPE environment variable is required for fa provider" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  if [ -z "${FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG:-}" ]; then
    echo "Error: FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG is required for fa provider — a JSON object with at least {\"baseUrl\", \"model\"} (fa never guesses catalog defaults), e.g." >&2
    echo "  FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG='{\"baseUrl\":\"https://ai-proxy.lab.epam.com\",\"model\":\"gpt-4o\",\"apiKeyEnvVar\":\"DIAL_API_KEY\"}'" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # Surface the config's key env var name so the runner can map
  # FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY into it for the subprocess when the var itself
  # is unset.
  FA_KEY_ENV_VAR="$(printf '%s' "${FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG}" | sed -n 's/.*"apiKeyEnvVar"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"
}

run_fa() {
  _fa_resolve_env || return 1

  _fa_configure_session

  echo "Fa Configuration:"
  echo "  Provider Type: ${FA_PROVIDER_TYPE}"
  [ -n "${FA_PROVIDER_NAME:-}" ] && echo "  Entry Name: ${FA_PROVIDER_NAME}"
  echo "  Config: ${FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG}"

  local pass_args=()
  local arg
  for arg in ${PASS_ARGS[@]+"${PASS_ARGS[@]}"}; do
    case "$arg" in
      --continue|--resume) ;;
      *) pass_args+=("$arg") ;;
    esac
  done

  # Provider selection is driven entirely by the FA_PROVIDER_* env
  # preconfig (fa precedence: explicit flags > preconfig > saved config).
  # No --provider/--model/--base-url flags here — the env declaration is
  # the single source of truth and pins every model role.
  local cmd
  cmd=(fa)
  if [ -n "${FA_SESSION_NAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${FA_SESSION_ROOT:-}" ]; then
    cmd+=(--session "${FA_SESSION_NAME}" --session-root "${FA_SESSION_ROOT}")
  fi
  # FA_LOG_FILE (optional): tee fa's full stdout trace (assistant text, tool
  # calls) to this file — untruncated, unlike the terminal-width trajectory
  # rows. CI tails/uploads it; requires fa >= v0.1.335 (--log-file).
  # Callers can still pass --log-file explicitly via PASS_ARGS.
  if [ -n "${FA_LOG_FILE:-}" ] \
    && ! printf '%s\n' ${pass_args[@]+"${pass_args[@]}"} | grep -qx -- '--log-file'; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "${FA_LOG_FILE}")"
    cmd+=(--log-file "${FA_LOG_FILE}")
  fi
  cmd+=(${pass_args[@]+"${pass_args[@]}"} -p "$PROMPT")

  echo "Working directory: $(pwd)"
  echo ""
  echo "Running: ${cmd[*]}"
  echo ""

  local agent_log
  agent_log="$(mktemp)"

  # Map FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY into the env var the config's apiKeyEnvVar
  # names — ONLY for the fa subprocess (claude.sh maps CLAUDE_CODE_* →
  # ANTHROPIC_* the same way) so it never leaks into the surrounding job
  # environment. When the caller already exported the named var, fa reads
  # it directly and nothing is injected.
  set +e
  if [ -n "${FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY:-}" ] && [ -n "${FA_KEY_ENV_VAR:-}" ] \
     && [ -z "$(eval "echo \${${FA_KEY_ENV_VAR}:-}")" ]; then
    env "${FA_KEY_ENV_VAR}=${FA_PROVIDER_API_KEY}" "${cmd[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$agent_log"
  else
    "${cmd[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$agent_log"
  fi
  local exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  set -e

  record_codegraph_usage "$agent_log"
  rm -f "$agent_log"

  echo ""
  echo "=== Agent completed with exit code: $exit_code ==="
  return $exit_code
}

# Configure the deterministic session when the setup script is available
# (repo-local runs may not have it — fa then runs without a named session).
# Runs inside run_fa's caller context, NOT at source time: sourcing here
# would otherwise run before the provider env validation and leak setup
# vars into unrelated shells.
_fa_configure_session() {
  local setup_dir
  setup_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../setup" 2>/dev/null && pwd || true)"
  if [ -z "${FA_SESSION_NAME:-}" ] && [ -f "${setup_dir}/fa-session.sh" ]; then
    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    source "${setup_dir}/fa-session.sh" env
  fi
}

# Factory · AI Teammate leg — REUSABLE workflow (dmtools-agents factory pack, top-level: GitHub requires reusable workflows at the .github/workflows root — no subdirectories).
#
# The dev→review→rewor…

blocks.text:
# Factory · AI Teammate leg — REUSABLE workflow (dmtools-agents factory pack, top-level: GitHub requires reusable workflows at the .github/workflows root — no subdirectories).
#
# The dev→review→rework machine loop for GitHub-issues trackers, hosted in
# dmtools-agents so target repositories carry only a thin stub (event
# triggers + this call) plus .dmtools/config.js, secrets and vars. Runs in
# the CALLER's context: github.repository = the target repo; vars.* and
# secrets.* resolve from the caller (each target pins its own versions).
#
# Legs (guard derives the slot when `leg` is empty):
#   bug | story | review | rework — the runner configs live in the TARGET repo
#   (.dmtools/runners/*), wired via .dmtools/config.js sm.runners.
#
# Loop mechanics (identical to the dmtools-dart template this was ported
# from — see that file's history for the full rationale):
#   issue assigned/labeled → guard → ticket input → dmtools run <runner>
#   → agent develops → PR ("Closes #NN") → review verdict step:
#       APPROVE + green PR checks → pr_approved → merge (merge-trigger/stub)
#       CHANGES_REQUESTED        → agent:rework (bounded: MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS,
#                                  then needs-human escalation)
#   Review/rework queue labels are stripped at cycle end (no self-loops).
#   fa sessions ride the fa-sess/gh-<n> branch (cache saves are denied on
#   issues-event runs); fa project memory is committed back to the repo.
#
# Secrets (via `secrets: inherit`): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (PAT — labels added
#   with GITHUB_TOKEN never fire `labeled` events; pushes must not author
#   as github-actions[bot]), ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY.
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
#   MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS (default 2).
#
# Caller stub:
#   on:
#     issues: {types: [assigned, labeled]}
#     workflow_dispatch: {inputs: {issue: {type: number}, leg: {type: string}}}
#   concurrency:
#     group: ai-teammate-issue-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue }}
#     cancel-in-progress: false
#   jobs:
#     factory:
#       uses: IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml@<ref>
#       with:
#         issue: ${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue }}
#         leg: ${{ inputs.leg || '' }}
#         reason: ${{ inputs.reason || 'stub' }}
#       secrets: inherit

name: 'Factory · AI Teammate'

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner:
        description: 'Runner label (self-hosted pools must be visible to the CALLING org)'
        type: string
        default: 'ubuntu-24.04'
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (string: number-typed reusable inputs cannot take expressions). Empty when pr is given (PR-anchored run, #687).'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored runs (review leg on PRs born without an issue, #687). Exactly one of issue|pr must be set.'
        required: false
        type: string
      machine-author:
        description: "Deployment's machine (bot) login (#687): gates rework re-arm in PR-anchored reviews (auto-approve via pr_approved is author-agnostic per the owner rule). Injected as jobParams.machineAuthor — branch-independent (the checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config)."
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: "Which leg to run: dev | review | rework (empty = derive from labels/assignees)"
        required: false
        type: string
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      factory_ref:
        description: 'The dmtools-agents ref the factory runs from (the literal in the stub uses-line). github.workflow_ref cannot serve: in a called workflow it carries the CALLER ref, not the uses-ref.'
        required: true
        type: string
      flutter-version:
        description: 'Flutter SDK for agent work (cached). "" (default) installs NOTHING — most consumers are not Flutter projects and bring their own toolchain via the setup/install scripts. A value installs Flutter+matching Dart via flutter-action with SDK caching (e.g. "stable", "3.38.0"); Flutter targets (fa) pass it explicitly.'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 1 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY2_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 2 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY3_NAME:
        description: 'Env var name for slot 3 (plain input, not secret).'
        required: false
        type: string

    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN:
        description: 'PAT with repo scope — machine labels, pushes, PR/issue API (secrets: inherit does not cross repository boundaries).'
        required: true
      ZAI_CODE_KEY:
        description: 'z.ai API key (dev/rework provider + review queue fallback)'
        required: false
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY:
        description: 'kimi API key (review provider, first in the queue)'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 1 — value lands in the agent job env under CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME. The factory never knows key names; the caller stub documents which repo secret maps here.'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY2:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 2 — see CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1.'
        required: false
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY3:
        description: 'Generic provider-key slot 3 — see CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1.'
        required: false

# NOTE: no `concurrency` here — the caller stub owns the per-issue group.
# A reusable workflow with the SAME group as its caller deadlocks: the caller
# holds the group while the called workflow waits for it forever (pending, 0 jobs).

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  # actions/cache@v6 save phase needs actions:write on github.token.
  actions: write

jobs:
  guard:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.check.outputs.run }}
      runner: ${{ steps.check.outputs.runner }}
      config: ${{ steps.check.outputs.config }}
      kind: ${{ steps.check.outputs.kind }}
      anchor: ${{ steps.check.outputs.anchor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout target repository (config, runners)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # caller-repo checkout: the factory reads .dmtools/config.js from
          # the TARGET repository, never from the factory pack
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          # gate job only: config.js at the head + API guards — no git
          # history walks. fetch-depth 0 cloned the FULL history here
          # (~1 min on fa, every leg) for nothing.
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Decide whether this event is for the agent
        id: check
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          # Event context rides through from the caller (issues events) —
          # empty for pure dispatches. The guard ALWAYS refreshes from the
          # API (queued runs see a stale payload); this is only a fallback.

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file carries
# only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository event
# triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a workflow run
    # that queued BEHIND the concurrency group for the whole leg duration
    # (live: gh-317/gh-318 twins, 20:01→20:03); the in-run dedupe gate cannot
    # act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole run pending before any
    # job (incl. dedupe) starts. The awf guard skips status echoes at
    # evaluation, so no double EXECUTION — but the queue clutter was real.
    # Leg dispatching is dispatch-only: the SM dispatches review/rework
    # (workflow_dispatch, inputs.leg), the manual rework override (#544) is a
    # dispatch with leg=rework instead of the agent:rework label.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-266');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes
  # across unrelated PRs.
  group: ai-teammate-issue-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue || format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  dedupe:
    # First-wins: the `issues` trigger fires on assigned AND labeled, so one
    # manual launch can dispatch two dev legs minutes apart (live gh-305 twin,
    # 2026-09-30: 36767724353 in_progress + 36767943650 pending behind the
    # concurrency group, both event=issues). The concurrency group only
    # SERIALIZES twins — this gate makes the younger run self-cancel when an
    # older live run of this workflow already anchors the same issue/pr.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      duplicate: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.duplicate }}
    steps:
      - name: Self-cancel if an identical live leg already holds the anchor
        id: gate
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ANCHOR: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue || format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr) }}
        run: |
          case "$ANCHOR" in
            pr-*) T="$ANCHOR" ;;
            *)    T="gh-$ANCHOR" ;;
          esac
          LIVE=$( { gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow ai-teammate.yml --status in_progress --json databaseId,displayTitle --jq '.[]'
                    gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow ai-teammate.yml --status queued    --json databaseId,displayTitle --jq '.[]'
                    gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow ai-teammate.yml --status pending   --json databaseId,displayTitle --jq '.[]'
                  } | jq -s --argjson self '${{ github.run_id }}' --arg t "$T" '
                    [ .[]
                      | select(.databaseId != $self)
                      | select(.displayTitle | test("(^|[^0-9])" + $t + "([^0-9]|$)")) ]
                    | length')
          if [ "${LIVE:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::notice::identical live leg holds $T — cancelling this duplicate ($LIVE holder(s) found)"
            echo "duplicate=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            gh run cancel "${{ github.run_id }}" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" || true
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "duplicate=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  factory:
    needs: dedupe
    if: needs.dedupe.outputs.duplicate != 'true'
    # TWO PINS, never conflated (see test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart):
    #   uses:  — the FACTORY HOME pin (dmtools-agentic-workflows). Moves
    #            only when the factory home changes; never bumped with
    #            the agents submodule.
    #   factory_ref: — the ENGINE pin (dmtools-agents, == the `agents`
    #            submodule gitlink). Bumps in lockstep with the submodule.
    # The uses: ref tracks awf main (always-latest, owner 2026-10-04 —
    # review-gated); the engine pin (factory_ref = submodule gitlink)
    # stays an immutable SHA.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-teammate.yml@main
    with:
      # The literal uses-ref: the factory requires it (it cannot derive its
      # own ref — github.workflow_ref in a called workflow is the CALLER's).
      factory_ref: d22a4f1032e2cd441200ed1a8309234985385fd2
      # Bitrise Build Hub pool (epam-org visible; probe #229).
      runner: BITRISE-RUNNER-DMTOOLS-CI
      issue: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue }}
      leg: ${{ github.event.inputs.leg || '' }}
      reason: ${{ github.event.inputs.reason || 'stub' }}
      pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr || '' }}
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      # Provider-key slots (generic, awf 75c72a6): slot -> key mapping is
      # documented HERE, next to the secret reference. Slot 1 carries the
      # copilot enterprise token (copilot provider, first in the queue —
      # see .dmtools/runners/*.json apiKeyEnv). Slots 2-3 free.
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME: COPILOT_EPAM_KEY
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect: inherit => startup failure, explicit => green).
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ZAI_CODE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_CODE_KEY }}
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY: ${{ secrets.KIMI_REVIEW_KEY }}
      # Slot 1 = COPILOT_EPAM_KEY — plain repo secret, runner-masked
      # natively; the factory exports it into the agent job env under the
      # name given in with.CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1_NAME above.
      CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEY1: ${{ secrets.COPILOT_EPAM_KEY }}
# DMTOOLS_PACK_REGISTRY (pack registry base) is read by the factory from
# this repo's VARIABLE of the same name — see dmtools-agents#574.
